messages.text: Where do I find my account with the store credit in it?

Store credit sits on your store account, not as a code. Log in at checkout with (email hidden) and the balance shows up as a payment option at the payment step, applied automatically.

You've got $70 on there from August. The $324.48 for the NerdQX is set to go on the same account the moment your unit lands at our Chattanooga warehouse, so it isn't there yet.

Label reference Shop···· on the outside of the box. Anything else you want me to check?
Where do you log in at?

Top right of heliumdeploy.com there's an account icon, or go straight to heliumdeploy.com/account/login. Put in (email hidden) and it emails you a six digit code, no password to remember. Once you're in, the credit shows on your account and it appears as a payment choice at checkout.

If the credit doesn't show when you're logged in, tell me and I'll sort it out.
Nope, just a drop down menu.

Skip the menu then. Type this straight into your browser's address bar: heliumdeploy.com/account/login

That's the login page. Enter (email hidden), it emails a six digit code, paste it in and you're on your account.

Does that page load for you?

Good. Your $70 balance should be sitting there, and the $324.48 from the NerdQX joins it once your unit reaches our Chattanooga warehouse. At checkout the credit shows as a payment option and comes off the total automatically.

Anything else I can check for you, Zach?
How long to process returns. Item arrived today at your warehouse

Carrier delivery and warehouse check-in aren't the same moment, so it's still showing as in transit on our side. Receiving usually scans it in within a day or two of it landing.

Your $324.48 is set to go onto your account automatically as soon as that scan happens, so it's not waiting on anyone to review it. Processing can take up to 10 days, but the credit doesn't wait for that.

I'll keep an eye on it.

Anytime, Zach.

One thing while you're here: when you hit the top right of the site, you got a dropdown instead of an account link. Were you on a phone or a desktop? Knowing that helps us fix it for the next person.
I am on a phone in desktop view

That explains it. Desktop view on a phone squeezes the header, so the account icon folds into that menu. I'll pass it on so the account link stays visible there.

Thanks for the detail, and for sticking with us through this one. You're all set on the return, and I'll be watching for the check-in scan.

You're welcome, Zach. A copy of this chat comes to your email once we're done.

If anything looks off once the credit lands, come straight back here. Good luck with the next build.
